profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a nonprofit open-source foundation that develops and maintains Blender, a free and open-source 3D creation software suite. The software covers a broad range of disciplines including 3D modeling, rendering, rigging, animation, camera and object tracking, Grease Pencil 2D drawing, and VFX work. Blender 5.2 LTS is the current release, introducing features such as a Cycles Texture Cache for more memory-efficient rendering of scenes with many image textures, new Grease Pencil texture brushes, and an Online Essentials Asset Library with procedural material customization. The foundation also operates Blender Studio, which produces original projects including a feature film announced under the title OVERGROWN. Blender is a member of the Academy Software Foundation, the Khronos Group, the Linux Foundation, and the Open Invention Network, and the site notes hardware support from AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm.

On the AI side, the foundation's tracked product is Blender AI Add-ons, a category of third-party and community plugins for 3D creation that run locally and are described as open-source, with model provenance noted as varying by plugin. Blender's Python API and its ecosystem of community add-on developers form the foundation for this expanding layer of tooling. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are held for the organization.
